CHRISTMAS EVENT BATTLE\nDefeat Glocke!!
Mmm-mm-hmmmm♪\nNice, the sleigh bells are fantastic too this\nyear!
It sounds as if a flash of lightning were rolling\nacross the five-line staff.
Is that Glocke?
He doesn't seem like a violent guy, but I think\nthe last thing he said was a bit weird~.
Welp, we'll find out once we talk to him.
Hi!\nAre you Glocke?
Hm? Aha, looks like we have some rare visitors\nhere. It's been ages since a thief last showed up\nin this music hall.
What? A thief?\nWait a minute!\nI think there's a misunderstanding here!
Yeah, whatever. Thieves and the like used to show\nup. Day or night, it didn't matter. There are\nvaluable instruments here, so I'm not surprised...
But I couldn't just ignore it. I made them leave\nin a slightly violent way. And the result?\nThieves stopped coming.
Wait, is it just me, or is this conversation\ngetting a little dangerous?
Yeah...\nI guess he thinks we're thieves, right?
Normally, your heads would already be rolling on\nthe floor...But somehow, you're incredibly lucky.
I've grown a bit tired of dealing with thieves,\ntoo. No, scratch that. Even if you're thieves,\nI'd enjoy talking with you if you're into music.
As I said, it's been a while since I last had a\nvisitor.
What? Really?
Will you also let us borrow your instruments?
Oh, is that why you're here? Well, after seeing\nthe collections in this music hall, I totally get\nit if you are tempted to play a piece or two...
Hm, alright...I can't give it to you, but I'll let\nyou borrow one. You can pick the instrument you\nlike.
Awesome!\nThat makes things a lot easier!
Thanks, Glocke!
Hm, don't thank me too early. I'll only let you\nborrow the instrument if you can prove that you\ntruly love music.
If you can convince me that you truly love music,\nI'll make it work for you.
What if we fail to convince you?
Hm, then having you walk around this music hall\nlike you own the place is a serious problem.\nI'll have to make your heads roll on the floor.
Hey, now we're suddenly in big trouble!
It's gonna be fine as long as we can prove that we\ntruly love music! Let's leave this to the\nadventurer!
Hey, do your best!
You guys should stop turning to us every time\nthings get tough~!
You're a problem too! Don't just go along with\nwhatever they say so easily!!
Alright, it's time for me to ask you some\nmusic-related questions. Please listen carefully.
Hey, how did you even pull that instrument out?
If you love music, it's easy.\nNow, listen.
Listen to the timbre of this horn...\nNow tell me, what does it sound like to you?!
Beautiful mountain spring water
I think that's fine.\nThat's what it sounds like to me.
Oh dear, I guess there's no use talking to you.\nIt seems that we're not on the same page when it\ncomes to music.
Munching on delicious sweets
Sweets are essential for Xmas!\nThat must be the right answer!
Like the sound of crunching sweets in your\nmouth...?
Well, not a bad answer, but I can't help feeling\nlike something is missing.
A deadly cannon explosion!
What the hey?!\nThat's definitely not the right answer!
Yup! Good answer! A boom that echoes, with chunks\nof flesh flying in all directions! That's a horn!\nArt is an explosion!
Don't you think Glocke's taste is kinda weird?
Yeah, it's a bit unsettling indeed...\nWell, that's how art is.
Hm, alright then, second question.
This time, I want you to describe the timbre of\nthis violin using your creativity!
Spring breeze over the grassland
That's good~.\nI don't see anything wrong with that answer.
Hm, you're hopeless when it comes to appreciating\nart. I expected a bit more fun. Could you just\nleave, please?
Reliable lumberjacks on parade
A lumberjack squad!\nTheir biceps are hard as rock!\nOh, now I need to flex mine too!
Hmm, I can feel the passion, but it doesn't\ncapture the violin's incredible destructive and\ncutting power at all.
Crunchy strings! A violin storm!
What are you saying?\nThere's no way an instrument could sound like\nthat!
Yeah! I've been waiting for that answer!\nBeautiful splashes of blood and gleaming strings!\nThat crack-and-crunch sound is the best!
Somehow I envy you. Your music taste is\nfirst-class! You seem like the perfect companion\nto talk about music!
Hey, what are you talking about?
The stuff you say is the weirdest, Glocke!
Hmm, you don't get what I'm saying? Once you\ndevelop a music taste like mine, a world of mere\nflowers and butterflies won't impress you anymore.
Those timbres symbolize power! Da-da-da-daaah!\nThe horn goes boom! The violin goes slaaash!\nThe lute goes strummm! The maracas go baaang!
Mmm, this is just too good!\nThis is what I call the ultimate joy of music!
Oh no...
The whole story about the anti-Xmas monster\nbecomes clear now...
And after assessing your love for music...
I think I should stop talking to you.\nAny further conversation with you will only ruin\nmy music taste.
I mean, your passion for music isn't bad.
But it's just normal.\nA true art master must sometimes learn to love\nabsurdity.
Well, considering your passion for music and love\nfor instruments, I genuinely think we could be\nsoulmates.
But it seems you've crossed the line...\nI don't want anyone more talented than me in music\nto exist in this world!
So, as per our agreement, you all must die!\nNow, lemme see those heads roll on the floor!
Wait, what~?!\nHe suddenly gets so pumped up!
I'm done playing nice!\nHey, let's fight him!
The harmony of destruction and this melody...\nI-isn't it incredible?
Okay, now let's find the instrument that's just\nright for magic from his collection!
But we really have no clue which one is right.
We should have asked the Great Spirit.
She probably doesn't know either. It's not her\nfield...
Hmm, magic, instrument, and the Great Spirit...\nSounds very interesting. Tell me more!
Whoa!!\nHe's still alive!!
Yeah, I'm alive.\nIt seems that I've become an immortal monster.
Anyway, tell me more about what you just said.\nI can feel it's going to take music to the next\nlevel!
...That's the story.
What a wonderful story! Using the power of music\nto help a blind girl! This will greatly deepen\npeople's understanding of music!
I'll help too, then!\nYou may take any instruments from the music hall.\nI'll take charge of the selection and performance.
Wow, nice! Thanks, Glocke!\nSuddenly, everything sorted out! I'm so happy!
Yeah, I know right.\nYou should have asked me for help earlier.
That's because you misunderstood us.\nYou thought we were thieves and you asked us silly\nquestions!
Now is the moment for me to present the crimson\nmelody of life! Let the horn, violin, and cymbals\nexplode! Yeah! This is starting to get fun!
Hey, don't ignore me!
It's okay, as long as he's willing to help!
Let's heal that girl's pain and cheer her up with\nthe Great Spirit's magic song!
